name: dwordPatchInitAt

name: dwordPatchWrite

name: dwordWriteGuarded

name: patchListAppendNode
purpose: Appends a 16-byte patch record (a2[0..2]) to a patch-list vector by copying it to the write cursor (*(a1+8)) and advancing that cursor by 16.

name: luaDCheckstack
purpose: Lua VM stack-growth guard that validates a requested slot count against LUAI_MAXCSTACK (8000) and, if the stack top would exceed capacity (base[7]-base[2] <= 16*n), calls luaD_growstack (sub_100447B0) and updates the CallInfo top field at *(ci+8).

name: luaDMoveResults

name: luaSetHookmask
purpose: Copies the 16-bit hook mask field at offset +52 from lua_State a1 into lua_State a2, propagating debug-hook flags between thread states.

name: luaSetAllocf
purpose: Getter/setter that swaps the allocation-function (or userdata) pointer stored at offset +88 of the global_State (*(a1+16)), returning the previous value.

name: luaPushCClosureAddr
purpose: lua_pushXXX helper that triggers luaC_checkGC (sub_10046780) when GCdebt threshold at global_State+68>=+64, allocates/wraps a value via sub_10050E40, stores it into the top TValue with tag 8 (LUA_TFUNCTION/thread), and bumps L->top by 16.

name: luaGetTop
purpose: lua_gettop implementation returning the stack index count as (L->top - L->base) >> 4 (dividing the byte delta by the 16-byte TValue size).

name: luaSetTop
purpose: lua_settop implementation that either rewinds L->top by |n| for negative indices or grows it forward, nil-initializing (tag word =0) each new TValue slot between old and new top.

name: luaRemove
purpose: lua_remove implementation that resolves the stack address via index2adr (sub_1003B170) then shifts every TValue above it down by one 16-byte slot and decrements L->top by 16.

name: luaIndex2Adr
purpose: index2adr core: maps a Lua stack index to a TValue* — positive indices from L->base, negative from L->top, and pseudo-indices LUA_REGISTRYINDEX(-10000), LUA_ENVIRONINDEX(-10001), LUA_GLOBALSINDEX(-10002) plus upvalue indices resolved off the current C closure, returning a sentinel &luaO_nilobject (unk_10066EF0) when out of range.

name: luaInsert
purpose: lua_insert implementation that resolves the target slot via index2adr (sub_1003B170) then rotates TValues upward, shifting each 16-byte slot up and placing the former top value into the opened position.

name: luaReplace
purpose: lua_replace implementation resolving the destination via index2adr, special-casing LUA_ENVIRONINDEX(-10001) to set the C closure's environment table (erroring via luaG_runerror/sub_10044220 with aNoCallingEnvir when no calling env) and running the write barrier luaC_barrier (sub_10047AC0) when storing a collectable, then popping L->top by 16.

name: luaPushvalue
purpose: lua_pushvalue implementation that resolves the source via index2adr (sub_1003B170), copies its full 16-byte TValue (value, tt, extra) onto L->top, and advances L->top by 16.

name: luaType
purpose: lua_type implementation returning the TValue tag word (v[2]) at the given index via index2adr, or LUA_TNONE(-1) when the slot equals the nilobject sentinel.

name: luaTypename
purpose: lua_typename implementation returning the C string name for a type tag, indexing the luaT_typenames table (off_10067270) or the literal aNoValue for tag -1 (LUA_TNONE).

name: luaIsCfunction
purpose: lua_iscfunction implementation resolving the slot via index2adr and returning true when the TValue tag is 6 (LUA_TFUNCTION) and the Closure's isC byte at *val+6 is set.

name: luaIsNumber
purpose: lua_isnumber implementation returning true when the index2adr TValue tag is 3 (LUA_TNUMBER) or the value is coercible to a number via luaV_tonumber (sub_100576F0) into a stack temp.

name: luaIsString
purpose: lua_isstring implementation that reads the type via lua_type (sub_1003B4E0) and returns true for tag 4 (LUA_TSTRING) or 3 (LUA_TNUMBER, which coerces to string).

name: luaEqual
purpose: lua_equal implementation resolving both operands via index2adr and returning 0 if either is the nilobject sentinel, else delegating to the primitive-equality comparator luaO_rawequalObj/equalobj (sub_1004C9E0).

name: luaLessthan
purpose: lua_lessthan implementation resolving both operands via index2adr, returning 0 if either is the nilobject sentinel, else delegating to the ordering comparator luaV_lessthan (sub_10057D10) with the lua_State for metamethod dispatch.

name: luaTonumber
purpose: lua_tonumber implementation returning the double at the index2adr slot when tag is 3 (LUA_TNUMBER), else coercing via luaV_tonumber (sub_100576F0) into a stack temp, or 0.0 on failure.

name: luaTointeger
purpose: lua_tointeger implementation reading the double from the index2adr slot (or coercing via luaV_tonumber sub_100576F0) and truncating it to an int, returning 0 when not numeric.

name: luaToboolean
purpose: lua_toboolean implementation resolving via index2adr and returning true unless the TValue is nil (tag 0) or a false boolean (tag 1 with value word 0).

name: luaTolstring
purpose: lua_tolstring implementation that resolves via index2adr, and if the value is not already a string (tag 4) coerces it in place via luaV_tostring (sub_10057750), running luaC_checkGC (sub_10046780) if needed, then re-resolves and returns the string's char data pointer (*val+16) and length via out-param a3.

name: luaObjlen
purpose: lua_objlen implementation switching on the index2adr TValue tag: string length (tag 4), coerced-string length for numbers (tag 3 via sub_10057750), table length via luaH_getn (sub_10054FD0) for tag 5, or userdata size (*val+16) for tag 7, else 0.

name: luaTocfunction
purpose: lua_tocfunction implementation resolving via index2adr and returning the C function pointer at *val+16 only when the TValue is a C closure (tag 6 with isC byte at *val+6 set), else 0.

name: luaTouserdata
purpose: lua_touserdata implementation resolving via index2adr and returning the raw data pointer for light userdata (tag 2, the value word itself) or full userdata (tag 7, *val+24 past the Udata header), else 0.

name: luaTothread
purpose: lua_tothread implementation resolving via index2adr and returning the lua_State pointer (value word) only when the TValue tag is 8 (LUA_TTHREAD), else 0.

name: luaTopointer
purpose: lua_topointer implementation switching on the index2adr TValue tag to return an identity pointer for functions/threads/userdata (tags 2/7 via sub_1003BAA0), tables (tag 5), functions (tag 6), and threads (tag 8), else 0.

name: luaPushnil
purpose: lua_pushnil implementation writing tag word 0 (LUA_TNIL) into the top TValue and advancing L->top by 16.

name: luaPushnumber

name: luaPushinteger
purpose: lua_pushinteger implementation converting int a2 to double, storing it into the top TValue with tag 3 (LUA_TNUMBER), and advancing L->top by 16.

name: luaPushlstring
purpose: lua_pushlstring implementation that runs luaC_checkGC (sub_10046780) on GC threshold, interns the buffer via luaS_newlstr (sub_100516B0), stores the resulting TString into the top TValue with tag 4 (LUA_TSTRING), and advances L->top by 16.

name: luaPushstring
purpose: lua_pushstring implementation that pushes nil (sub_1003BBC0) for a NULL pointer, else measures the C string with strlen and delegates to lua_pushlstring (sub_1003BC70).

name: luaPushvfstringWrap
purpose: lua_pushvfstring entry that runs luaC_checkGC (sub_10046780) on GC threshold then delegates formatted-string building to luaO_pushvfstring (sub_1004CB40) with the va_list argument pointer.

name: luaPushfstring
purpose: lua_pushfstring variadic implementation that runs luaC_checkGC (sub_10046780) then forwards the va_list to luaO_pushvfstring (sub_1004CB40) to build and push a formatted string.

name: luaPushcclosure
purpose: lua_pushcclosure implementation that runs luaC_checkGC (sub_10046780), resolves the closure environment via getcurrenv (sub_1003BEB0), allocates a C closure with a3 upvalues via luaF_newCclosure (sub_10045C20), stores the function pointer at +16, then pops a3 upvalue TValues off the stack into the closure body and pushes it with tag 6 (LUA_TFUNCTION).

name: luaGetcurrenv
purpose: getcurrenv helper returning the current environment table: L->env field (L[18]) when running at the base CallInfo (L[5]==L[10]), else the calling C closure's env pointer at *(ci->func)+12.

name: luaPushboolean
purpose: lua_pushboolean implementation storing the normalized boolean (a2!=0) into the top TValue with tag 1 (LUA_TBOOLEAN) and advancing L->top by 16.

name: luaPushlightuserdata
purpose: lua_pushlightuserdata implementation storing raw pointer a2 into the top TValue with tag 2 (LUA_TLIGHTUSERDATA) and advancing L->top by 16.

name: luaPushthread
purpose: lua_pushthread implementation storing the lua_State pointer into the top TValue with tag 8 (LUA_TTHREAD), advancing L->top by 16, and returning true when this thread is the global_State main thread (*(G+112)==L).

name: luaGettable
purpose: lua_gettable implementation resolving the table via index2adr and performing a keyed read via luaV_gettable (sub_100577E0) using the popped key at L->top-16, writing the result back into that same slot.

name: luaGetfield
purpose: lua_getfield implementation resolving the table via index2adr, interning the field-name C string via luaS_newlstr (sub_100516B0) into a temp key TValue with tag 4, and calling luaV_gettable (sub_100577E0) to push the looked-up value onto L->top.

name: luaRawget
purpose: lua_rawget implementation resolving the table via index2adr and performing a metamethod-free lookup via luaH_get (sub_10054900) with the popped key at L->top-16, writing the raw result back into that slot.

name: luaRawgeti
purpose: lua_rawgeti implementation resolving the table via index2adr and fetching array element a3 via luaH_getnum (sub_10054820), copying the resulting TValue onto L->top and advancing top by 16.

name: luaCreatetable
purpose: lua_createtable implementation that runs luaC_checkGC (sub_10046780) then allocates a new table sized for a2 array and a3 hash slots via luaH_new (sub_10054720), pushing it onto L->top with tag 5 (LUA_TTABLE).

name: luaGetmetatable
purpose: lua_getmetatable implementation resolving via index2adr and fetching the metatable from a table/userdata (tag 5/7 at *val+8) or the per-type default at G->mt array (a1[4]+4*tag+152), pushing it with tag 5 and returning 1, or 0 when absent.

name: luaGetfenv
purpose: lua_getfenv implementation resolving via index2adr and pushing the environment table of a closure (tags 6/7 at *val+12), a userdata's env, or a thread's global-table gt (tag 8 at *val+72), else pushing nil.

name: luaSetTable
purpose: lua_settable implementation resolving the table via index2adr and performing a keyed write via luaV_settable (sub_10057A70) with key at L->top-32 and value at L->top-16, then popping both by decrementing L->top by 32.

name: luaPushLString
purpose: Lua C-API lua_pushlstring: converts a fixed index via sub_1003B170, strlen's the C string, interns it with luaS_newlstr (sub_100516B0), sets the TValue tag to 4 (LUA_TSTRING) and advances the stack top L->top (a1[2]).

name: luaRawGet
purpose: Lua C-API lua_rawget: resolves the table TValue at index a2, does a raw hash lookup luaH_get (sub_100549C0) with the top key, copies the resulting TValue back over the key slot, and runs the write-barrier check (bit tests on GC marks + sub_10047B20/luaC_barrier) before popping one slot.

name: luaRawGetI

name: luaSetTableEnvOrRegistry

name: luaSetMetatable

name: luaSetTop

name: luaPCallProtected

name: luaPCallInvokeThunk

name: luaCPCall

name: luaCPCallTrampoline

name: luaLError
purpose: lauxlib luaL_error: substitutes a default empty-message string when a4 is null, formats the location+message via luaL_where-style builder sub_1005AB00 into a stack buffer, and raises the error with sub_10045540 (lua_error).

name: luaCallMeta
purpose: lauxlib luaL_callmeta helper: inspects the top TValue, and if it is a table (tag6) with a live metatable flag clear it invokes the metamethod lookup/call path luaL_getmetafield+lua_call (sub_100456F0) using the metafield name args a2/a3.

name: luaGC

name: luaNext
purpose: Lua C-API lua_next: resolves the table at index a2, advances the iterator with luaH_next (sub_10053F40) using the key on top; on success grows the stack by one (key+value pushed) else pops the stale key.

name: luaConcat

name: luaNewUserdata
purpose: Lua C-API lua_newuserdata: performs a GC-step check, computes required size via sub_1003BEB0, allocates the userdata block with luaS_newudata (sub_100518C0), pushes it onto the stack with tag 7 (LUA_TUSERDATA), and returns the pointer to the data payload (block+24).

name: luaGetUpvalue
purpose: Lua C-API lua_getupvalue: resolves the closure at index a2, fetches upvalue slot a3 via sub_1003CE40, and if present copies that upvalue TValue onto the stack top and advances L->top.

name: luaClosureUpvalRef

name: luaSetUpvalue

name: luaLArgError
purpose: lauxlib luaL_argerror: inspects the current activation frame via lua_getstack/lua_getinfo (sub_10042BF0/sub_10042ED0), and raises a formatted 'bad argument #%d' or 'calling on bad self' error via luaL_error (sub_1003D170).

name: luaLTypeError
purpose: lauxlib luaL_typerror: builds a 'TYPE expected, got ACTUAL' message using lua_type/luaL_typename (sub_1003B4E0/sub_1003B520) and lua_pushfstring (sub_1003BD70), then forwards to luaL_argerror (sub_1003CFC0).

name: luaLWhere
purpose: lauxlib luaL_where: calls lua_getstack+lua_getinfo (sub_10042BF0/sub_10042ED0) with the 'Sl' what-string, and if a valid current-line is found pushes a '%s:%d: ' source-location prefix via lua_pushfstring (sub_1003BD70) else an empty string.

name: luaLErrorVararg

name: luaLCheckOption

name: luaLGetMetatable

name: luaLCheckUData

name: luaLCheckStack
purpose: lauxlib luaL_checkstack: calls lua_checkstack (sub_1003AE80) to grow the stack by a2 slots and raises luaL_error 'stack overflow (%s)' via sub_1003D170 if the growth request fails.

name: luaLCheckType
purpose: lauxlib luaL_checktype: reads lua_type (sub_1003B4E0) at index a2 and if it differs from expected tag a3 diverts to the tag-error path sub_1003D3F0 (luaL_typerror).

name: luaLTypeErrorByTag
purpose: lauxlib type-error thunk: converts the expected type tag a3 to its name via luaT_typenames lookup (sub_1003B520) and raises luaL_typerror (sub_1003D090).

name: luaLCheckAny
purpose: lauxlib luaL_checkany: reads lua_type (sub_1003B4E0) at index a2 and raises luaL_argerror 'value expected' (sub_1003CFC0) when the slot is LUA_TNONE (-1).

name: luaLCheckLString

name: luaLOptLString

name: luaLCheckNumber

name: luaLOptNumber
purpose: lauxlib luaL_optnumber: returns the caller default double a3 when the arg slot is nil/none, otherwise delegates to luaL_checknumber (sub_1003D500).

name: luaLCheckInteger
purpose: lauxlib luaL_checkinteger: reads a lua_Integer via lua_tointeger (sub_1003B850) at index a2 and raises a LUA_TNUMBER type-error (sub_1003D3F0, tag 3) when it is 0 and the slot isn't a number (sub_1003B5A0).

name: luaLOptInteger
purpose: lauxlib luaL_optinteger: returns the caller default integer a3 when the arg slot is nil/none, otherwise delegates to luaL_checkinteger (sub_1003D5A0).

name: luaLGetMetafield
purpose: lauxlib luaL_getmetafield: fetches the metatable of the value at index a2 (lua_getmetatable sub_1003C1C0), pushes the field name Str and does a raw get (lua_rawget sub_1003C080); returns 1 leaving the field on the stack if non-nil, else cleans up and returns 0.

name: luaLCallMetaField

name: luaLGSub
purpose: Thin wrapper forwarding to the buffer-based global-substitute helper luaL_gsub (sub_1003D750) with a null final argument.

name: luaLRegisterModule

name: luaLRegCount

name: luaLGSubImpl

name: luaLFindTable
purpose: lauxlib luaL_findtable: walks a dotted 'a.b.c' module path, splitting on '.' and for each segment doing lua_rawget (sub_1003C080); creating intermediate tables (lua_newtable sub_1003C150, lua_setfield sub_1003C340) as needed, returning null on success or the offending segment on type conflict.

name: luaLPrepBuffer
purpose: lauxlib luaL_prepbuffer: if the luaL_Buffer is full flushes it (sub_1003DB30 adjuststack + sub_1003DB90 emptybuffer) and returns a pointer to the buffer's writable area (base+12).

name: luaLBufferFlushToStack

name: luaLBufferAdjustStack

name: luaLAddLString
purpose: lauxlib luaL_addlstring: copies a3 bytes from a2 into the luaL_Buffer, flushing via luaL_prepbuffer (sub_1003DB00) whenever the inline buffer (base+131 words) fills.

name: luaLAddString
purpose: lauxlib luaL_addstring: strlen's the C string and appends it to the luaL_Buffer via luaL_addlstring (sub_1003DC40).

name: luaZ_closeStringBuffer

name: luaZ_bufferAppendChunk

name: luaZ_initBuffer

name: luaL_loadFileChunk

name: luaL_fileReaderCallback

name: luaL_reportFileError

name: luaL_loadBufferChunk
purpose: Implements luaL_loadbuffer: packs the {data,size} pair into a stack struct and drives the parser sub_1003C9B0 with the single-shot reader sub_1003E330 under chunkname a4.

name: luaL_bufferReaderCallback
purpose: lua_Reader for luaL_loadbuffer: returns the buffered data pointer and its length once, then zeroes the length field so the next call returns 0 signalling EOF.

name: luaL_loadStringChunk
purpose: Implements luaL_loadstring: computes strlen(Str) and forwards to luaL_loadbuffer (sub_1003E300) using the string itself as both buffer and chunkname.

name: luaL_newStateDefault
purpose: Implements luaL_newstate: creates a lua_State via lua_newstate (sub_10051150) with the default realloc-based allocator sub_1003E3E0 and installs the panic handler sub_1003E410 through lua_atpanic (sub_1003AFD0).

name: luaDefaultAllocator
purpose: Default lua_Alloc: realloc(Block,Size) when Size>0, otherwise free(Block) and return NULL, ignoring the ud and old-size arguments.

name: luaDefaultPanicHandler
purpose: Default lua_atpanic handler: fetches the top error message via sub_1003B900 and fprintf's "PANIC: unprotected error in call to Lua API (%s)" to stderr (_iob_func()+2).

name: luaB_print
purpose: Implements Lua base print(): fetches the global tostring (sub_1003C000), calls it (sub_1003C780) on each of the lua_gettop args, and fputs each result plus tab/newline separators to stdout.

name: luaB_tonumber
purpose: Implements Lua base tonumber(): for base 10 uses lua_isnumber/lua_tonumber (sub_1003B5A0/sub_1003B800) to push the value, otherwise strtoul-parses the string in the given radix (validated 2..36) and pushes the result, or pushes nil on failure.

name: luaB_error
purpose: Implements Lua base error(): reads the optional level arg (default 1) and, for a string message at positive level, prepends position info via luaL_where (sub_1003D0F0) before raising via lua_error (sub_1003CBB0).

name: luaB_getmetatable
purpose: Implements Lua base getmetatable(): calls lua_getmetatable (sub_1003C1C0) on arg 1 and, if present, replaces it with the __metatable field via sub_1003D630, else pushes nil.

name: luaB_setmetatable
purpose: Implements Lua base setmetatable(): type-checks arg1 as table and arg2 as nil-or-table, refuses when a protected __metatable field exists (error "cannot change a protected metatable"), then lua_setmetatable (sub_1003C580) on arg 1.

name: luaB_getfenv
purpose: Implements Lua base getfenv(): resolves the target function's environment via getfunc helper sub_1003E840 and pushes either the global table (LUA_GLOBALSINDEX -10002) for a C function or lua_getfenv (sub_1003C270) of the Lua function.

name: luaB_getfunc
purpose: getfenv/setfenv helper: resolves an argument that is either a function value (lua_pushvalue) or a stack level integer, walks the call stack via lua_getstack (sub_10042BF0)/lua_getinfo (sub_10042ED0) with 'f' to push the function, erroring on invalid/negative levels.

name: luaB_setfenv
purpose: Implements Lua base setfenv(): type-checks the env table (arg2), resolves the target function via getfunc, and either sets the running thread's global env (level-0 case using sub_1003BF70) or lua_setfenv (sub_1003C690), erroring "setfenv cannot change environment of given object".

name: luaB_rawequal
purpose: Implements Lua base rawequal(): checks both args exist then pushes the boolean result of lua_rawequal (sub_1003B690) on args 1 and 2.

name: luaB_rawget
purpose: Implements Lua base rawget(): type-checks arg1 as a table and performs a metamethod-free lua_rawget (sub_1003C080) using the key at arg 2.

name: luaB_rawset
purpose: Implements Lua base rawset(): type-checks arg1 as a table and performs a metamethod-free lua_rawset (sub_1003C410) with key arg2 and value arg3, returning the table.

name: luaB_gcinfo
purpose: Implements Lua base gcinfo(): queries current allocated KB via lua_gc(LUA_GCCOUNT) (sub_1003CA70 mode 3) and pushes it as an integer.

name: luaB_collectgarbage
purpose: Implements Lua base collectgarbage(): maps the option string (via luaL_checkoption sub_1003D1D0 against off_10066A00) to a GC opcode in dword_10066A20, runs lua_gc (sub_1003CA70), and pushes count-as-KB (mode 3), boolean (mode 5), or numeric result.

name: luaB_type
purpose: Implements Lua base type(): calls lua_type (sub_1003B4E0) on arg1 and pushes the corresponding type-name string from lua_typename (sub_1003B520).

name: luaB_next
purpose: Implements Lua base next(): type-checks arg1 as a table, ensures arg2 (defaulting to nil) exists, and calls lua_next (sub_1003CBD0) to push the next key/value pair or nil at end of traversal.

name: luaB_loadstring
purpose: Implements Lua base loadstring(): reads the source string (sub_1003D450) and optional chunkname (sub_1003D490), calls luaL_loadbuffer (sub_1003E300), and reports the compiled chunk or (nil,errmsg) via sub_1003ED10.

name: luaB_loadResult
purpose: Shared load()/loadstring()/loadfile() return helper: on success (a2==0) returns 1 leaving the function, otherwise pushes nil beneath the error message and returns 2 for the (nil,message) idiom.

name: luaB_loadfile
purpose: Implements Lua base loadfile(): reads the optional filename (sub_1003D490), calls luaL_loadfile (sub_1003DF80), and returns the chunk or (nil,errmsg) via sub_1003ED10.

name: luaB_load
purpose: Implements Lua base load(): validates the reader function arg (LUA_TFUNCTION) and optional chunkname, then drives the parser sub_1003C9B0 with the generic-reader trampoline sub_1003EE00, returning via sub_1003ED10.

name: luaB_genericReaderCallback
purpose: lua_Reader for base load(): calls the user Lua reader function (lua_call sub_1003C780), returning NULL on nil/empty, erroring on non-string returns, and handing the string+len back to the parser via sub_1003B900.

name: luaB_dofile
purpose: Implements Lua base dofile(): loads the file via luaL_loadfile (sub_1003DF80, raising on load error via lua_error), runs it with a multret lua_call (sub_1003C780), and returns the count of results produced.

name: luaB_assert
purpose: Implements Lua base assert(): if arg1 is false/nil raises an error with the message arg (default "assertion failed!") via sub_1003D170, else returns all arguments unchanged.

name: luaB_unpack
purpose: Implements Lua base unpack(): type-checks arg1 as a table, reads optional i (arg2, default 1) and j (arg3, default luaL_getn/#t via sub_1003B9A0), checks stack space, and pushes t[i..j] via repeated lua_rawgeti (sub_1003C0E0).

name: luaB_select
purpose: Implements Lua base select(): if arg1 is the string "#" pushes the count of extra args, otherwise validates the index (supporting negative-from-end) and returns all arguments from that position onward.

name: luaB_pcall
purpose: Implements Lua base pcall(): calls lua_pcall (sub_1003C7E0) on the function plus its args with no error handler, then pushes the success boolean beneath the results and returns everything.

name: luaB_xpcall
purpose: Implements Lua base xpcall(): moves the error-handler arg (arg2) beneath the function, calls lua_pcall (sub_1003C7E0) with that handler index, and returns the status boolean followed by the results.

name: luaB_tostring
purpose: Implements Lua base tostring(): honors a __tostring metamethod (sub_1003D6B0) if present, else formats by lua_type — "nil"/"true"/"false", the raw string, the number pushed via lua_pushvalue, or "%s: %p" typename+pointer for other types.

name: luaB_costatus
purpose: Implements coroutine.status(): resolves the thread arg (lua_tothread sub_1003BAF0), computes its status index via sub_1003F3A0, and pushes the corresponding name string from off_10066B08 ("running"/"suspended"/"normal"/"dead").

name: luaCoroutineStatusIndex
purpose: Computes a coroutine status code (0 running-self,1 suspended,2 normal,3 dead) by comparing the thread to the caller and inspecting lua_status (sub_1003CA60) plus lua_getstack/gettop to distinguish suspended vs dead.

name: luaB_coresume
purpose: Implements coroutine.resume(): resolves the thread (sub_1003BAF0), resumes it with the extra args via helper sub_1003F4F0, and pushes (true, results...) on success or (false, errmsg) on failure.

name: luaCoroutineAuxResume
purpose: coroutine.resume/wrap core: moves the passed arguments into the coroutine, calls lua_resume, and on error moves the error message back to the caller stack; returns result count or a negative error indicator.

name: luaCoroutineNew
purpose: Shared coroutine.create/wrap constructor: creates a new thread with lua_newthread (sub_1003B000), validates arg1 is a non-C Lua function, and lua_xmoves (sub_1003AF20) the function into the new coroutine.

name: luaB_cowrap
purpose: Implements coroutine.wrap(): creates a coroutine via sub_1003F610 then pushes a C closure over sub_1003F6C0 (lua_pushcclosure sub_1003BDD0) capturing the thread as its upvalue.

name: luaCoroutineWrapResume
purpose: C closure body for coroutine.wrap: resumes the upvalue thread (LUA_UPVALUE -10003) via sub_1003F4F0 and, on error, augments the message with luaL_where (sub_1003D0F0) and re-raises via lua_error (sub_1003CBB0).

name: luaB_coyield
purpose: Implements coroutine.yield(): forwards all current stack values (lua_gettop) to lua_yield (sub_10045400).

name: luaB_corunning
purpose: Implements coroutine.running(): calls lua_pushthread (sub_1003BF70) and pushes nil instead when invoked from the main thread.

name: luaopenBase
purpose: Lua base-library opener that calls sub_1003F7D0 to register global base functions then registers the 'coroutine' library table via sub_1003D730 with off_10066B18, returning 2 result tables on the Lua stack.

name: registerBaseLib
purpose: Registers the Lua base library: sets global '_G' self-reference, '_VERSION'='Lua 5.1', installs ipairs/pairs closures via sub_1003FB20, builds a weak-mode 'kv' metatable, and defines 'newproxy' as a closure over sub_1003FA00 in the globals table (index -10002).

name: luaBIpairsAux
purpose: ipairs iterator lua_CFunction: luaL_checktype(1,LUA_TTABLE) via sub_1003D3C0, pushes the array-part table (index 1) and integer key, calls the raw-inext helper sub_1003BBC0, returning 3 stack values.

name: luaBInext
purpose: ipairs stepping lua_CFunction: reads current integer index via luaL_checkint (sub_1003D5A0), checks table type, pushes ++index via lua_pushinteger (sub_1003BC30), rawgeti (sub_1003C0E0), returning 2 values or 0 when the value is nil (sub_1003B4E0).

name: luaBPairs
purpose: pairs()/next-setup lua_CFunction: luaL_checktype table (sub_1003D3C0), pushes the traversal-state table (index -10003) and the table arg, then pushes integer 0 as the initial key (sub_1003BC30), returning 3 values for the generic-for protocol.

name: luaBNewproxy
purpose: newproxy lua_CFunction: creates a zero-userdata via lua_newuserdata (sub_1003CD40), and if the boolean/proxy arg is true or another proxy, clones/attaches its metatable (lua_getmetatable sub_1003C080, lua_setmetatable sub_1003C410), else raises luaL_argerror 'boolean or proxy expected'.

name: registerLuaPairClosure
purpose: Helper that registers a paired Lua closure: pushes the auxiliary C function a4 and the main C function a3 as lua_pushcclosure (sub_1003BDD0) then sets the named field on the table at stack -2 via lua_setfield (sub_1003C390).

name: luaKreserveRegs
purpose: lcode reservestack/setmultret helper that adjusts the FuncState free-register count (offsets +24/+28) and, for the last OP_CALL/OP_VARARG instruction, rewrites its C operand (>>23) to make it return multiple results, else emits an OP_SETLIST-style instruction via sub_10041920.

name: luaKjump
purpose: lcode luaK_jump: saves and clears the FuncState jump-to-target list (offset +32), emits an OP_JMP with max sBx offset 131070 via sub_10041A80, then concatenates the saved pending jumps onto it (sub_1003FF70), returning the new jump pc.

name: luaKcodeAsBx
purpose: lcode instruction emitter thunk that encodes an iAsBx-form opcode (30) with the given A operand and sBx=a3+1 bias, delegating to the raw instruction writer sub_10041920.

name: luaKgetLabel
purpose: lcode luaK_getlabel: marks the current pc (offset +24) as a jump target by setting lasttarget (offset +28) equal to it and returns the pc.

name: luaKpatchList
purpose: lcode luaK_patchlist: if the target equals the current pc it appends the jump list via sub_1003FF40 (patchtohere), otherwise patches each jump instruction's target and register via sub_1003FD20.

name: luaKpatchListAux
purpose: lcode patchlistaux: walks a linked jump list (getjump sub_1003FE10), and for each jump either fixes its target to a3 or to the default a5 depending on whether patchtestreg (sub_1003FE50) applied, via fixjump sub_1003FD90.

name: luaKfixJump
purpose: lcode fixjump: computes the sBx branch offset (dest - (pc+1)) with 0x1FFFF bias, raising 'control structure too long' via luaX_syntaxerror (sub_100492D0) if it overflows, and writes it into the instruction's Bx field.

name: luaKgetJump
purpose: lcode getjump: reads the sBx offset of the jump instruction at pc from the code array (proto+12), returning NO_JUMP (-1) when the encoded offset is the sentinel 131070, else pc+offset+1.

name: luaKpatchTestReg
purpose: lcode patchtestreg: inspects the instruction controlling a jump (getjumpcontrol sub_1003FEF0); if it's OP_TESTSET (0x1B) it either rewrites the target register A or converts it to OP_TEST (0x1A) when no register is needed, returning success.

name: luaKgetJumpControl
purpose: lcode getjumpcontrol: returns a pointer to the instruction preceding the jump at pc if that prior opcode is a test-mode instruction (byte_1006709C opmode table flag < 0), else the jump instruction itself.

name: luaKpatchToHere
purpose: lcode luaK_patchtohere: marks the current pc as a jump target (sub_1003FCC0) then concatenates the given jump list onto the FuncState's pending-here jump list at offset +32 via sub_1003FF70.

name: luaKconcatJump
purpose: lcode luaK_concat: links jump list a3 onto list *a2, either storing it directly if the list is empty or walking to the end of the chain (getjump sub_1003FE10) and fixing the last jump to point at a3 (sub_1003FD90).

name: luaKcheckStack
purpose: lcode luaK_checkstack: grows the FuncState's max-stack-size byte (proto+75) to accommodate n more registers (freereg at index [9]), raising luaX_syntaxerror 'function or expression too complex' via sub_100492D0 if it exceeds 250.

name: luaKreserveregs
purpose: lcode luaK_reserveregs: calls checkstack (sub_1003FFE0) then advances the FuncState freereg counter (index [9]) by n, returning the new freereg.

name: luaKstringK
purpose: lcode luaK_stringK helper: wraps a TString pointer into a TValue (type tag 4 = LUA_TSTRING) on a local descriptor and interns it into the proto constant table via addk (sub_100400A0).

name: luaKaddk
purpose: lcode addk: interns a constant TValue into the proto's constant array (proto+8/+40), using the FuncState's dedup hash table (luaH_set sub_100549C0), growing the array via luaM_growvector (sub_1004B630 'constant table overflow'), and barriering GC via luaC_barrier (sub_10047AC0).

name: luaKnumberK
purpose: lcode luaK_numberK: wraps a lua_Number (double, type tag 3 = LUA_TNUMBER) into a TValue and interns it into the proto constant table via addk (sub_100400A0).

name: luaKdischargeJpc
purpose: lcode helper that finalizes a VJMP/VRELOCABLE expdesc: for a relocable instruction (kind 13) it patches the A operand into the OP field, for kind 14 (comparison jump) it patches the target register and bumps freereg via reserveregs (sub_10040030).

name: luaKdischarge2reg
purpose: lcode discharge helper: converts a VRELOCABLE expdesc (kind 13) into VNONRELOC by reading the target register from its instruction, and for kind 14 sets the instruction's C flag and marks the expdesc as a true-value VTRUE (kind 11).

name: luaKdischargeVars
purpose: lcode luaK_dischargevars: resolves an expdesc's variable form into a value form, emitting OP_GETUPVAL/OP_GETGLOBAL/OP_GETTABLE (via sub_10041920/sub_10041A80) for VLOCAL/VUPVAL/VGLOBAL/VINDEXED kinds 6-9, and calling sub_10040320 for relocable/jump kinds 13-14.

name: luaKfreeReg
purpose: lcode freereg helper: if the operand is a stack register (not a constant, RKASK bit 0x100 clear) at or above nactvar (proto+50) it decrements the FuncState freereg counter at offset +36.

name: luaKexp2nextreg
purpose: lcode luaK_exp2nextreg: discharges variables (sub_100403A0), frees the expdesc's own register (sub_10040540), reserves one fresh register (reserveregs sub_10040030), then places the expression there via exp2reg (sub_10040560).

name: luaKfreeexp
purpose: lcode freeexp: if the expdesc is a VNONRELOC value (kind 12) it releases its backing register via freereg (sub_100404C0).

name: luaKexp2reg
purpose: lcode exp2reg: emits code to move an expression into register a3 (discharge2reg sub_10040750), resolves any pending true/false jump lists by generating OP_LOADBOOL fixups (sub_10040720) and patching both value lists (patchlistaux sub_1003FD20), then marks the expdesc VNONRELOC.

name: luaKneedValue
purpose: lcode need_value: walks a jump list and returns 1 if any jump's controlling instruction is not OP_TESTSET (0x1B), meaning a LOADBOOL value fixup is required.

name: luaKcodeLoadBool
purpose: lcode code_label helper: marks a jump target (getlabel sub_1003FCC0) then emits an OP_LOADBOOL instruction (opcode 2) with the given register, boolean value, and skip flag via sub_10041920.

name: luaKdischarge2regInner
purpose: lcode discharge2reg: emits the instruction that puts an expdesc value into register a2 — OP_LOADNIL/LOADBOOL/LOADK/LOADKNUM (sub_1003FB60/sub_10041920/sub_10041A80/sub_10040210), OP_MOVE for locals (kind C), or patches a relocable instruction's A field — then marks it VNONRELOC (kind 12).

name: luaKexp2anyreg
purpose: lcode luaK_exp2anyreg: discharges variables (sub_100403A0) and returns an existing register for a VNONRELOC expr with no pending jumps, otherwise pushes it to a fresh register via exp2reg/exp2nextreg (sub_10040560/sub_100404F0).

name: luaKexp2val
purpose: lcode exp2val: if the expdesc has pending jump lists it forces it into a register via exp2anyreg (sub_100408C0), otherwise just discharges variables (sub_100403A0).

name: luaKexp2RK
purpose: lcode luaK_exp2RK: converts an expdesc to an RK operand — interns constant nil/bool/number expressions into the constant table (sub_10040AD0/sub_10040A90/sub_10040210) and returns their index with the RKASK bit 0x100 set, or falls back to a register (exp2anyreg sub_100408C0).

name: luaKboolK
purpose: lcode boolK: wraps a boolean value (type tag 1 = LUA_TBOOLEAN) into a TValue and interns it into the proto constant table via addk (sub_100400A0).

name: luaKnilK
purpose: lcode nilK: interns a nil TValue (type tag 5, keyed by the lua_State pointer to dedup) into the proto constant table via addk (sub_100400A0).

name: luaKdischarge2anyreg
purpose: lcode helper dispatching on an operand expdesc kind (VINDEXED/VLOCAL/VUPVAL/VGLOBAL 6-9) to emit the correct load into an existing register — exp2reg, OP_SETUPVAL (8), OP_SETGLOBAL (7 via sub_10041A80), or OP_SETTABLE (9) — then freeing the temp (freeexp sub_10040540).

name: luaKindexed
purpose: lcode luaK_indexed/self: forces the table into a register and the key into an RK operand (exp2anyreg sub_100408C0, exp2RK sub_10040980), reserves 2 registers, emits OP_SELF (opcode 11) via sub_10041920, and rewrites the expdesc to VNONRELOC.

name: luaKgoiftrue
purpose: lcode luaK_goiftrue: dispatches on the expdesc kind (true/false/number/jump) to invert or emit the conditional test (jumponcond sub_10040DE0, OP_TEST fixups), concatenates the false-jump list, and patches the true list to here via patchtohere (sub_1003FF40).

name: luaKinvertJump
purpose: lcode invertjump: toggles the A (condition) flag of the OP_TEST/OP_TESTSET instruction controlling a jump (getjumpcontrol sub_1003FEF0) so the branch sense is reversed.

name: luaKjumponcond
purpose: lcode jumponcond: if the expdesc is a relocable OP_NOT it emits an inverted OP_TEST directly, otherwise discharges the expr to a register (sub_10040EC0/sub_10040540) and emits OP_TESTSET (27) plus a following jump via condjump (sub_10040E90).

name: luaKcondJump
purpose: lcode condjump: emits a conditional test instruction (sub_10041920) immediately followed by an OP_JMP (luaK_jump sub_1003FC50), returning the jump pc.

name: luaKdischarge2anyregSimple
purpose: lcode helper: if the expdesc is not already VNONRELOC (kind 12) it reserves a register (reserveregs sub_10040030) and discharges the value into the freereg-1 slot via discharge2reg (sub_10040750).

name: luaKsetVIndexedC
purpose: lcode helper that finalizes a comparison expdesc into a VINDEXED-style kind 9 by storing the RK-converted right operand (exp2RK sub_10040980) in field [3].

name: luaKprefix
purpose: lcode luaK_prefix: applies a unary operator to an expdesc — OP_UNM negation (codearith sub_10041180 opcode 18/20), OP_NOT via codenot (sub_10041020), or OP_LEN — after ensuring the operand is in a register (exp2anyreg sub_100408C0, isnumeral check sub_10040FE0).

name: luaK_isNumericConst
purpose: Lua code-generator predicate returning true when an expdesc (a1) is a VKNUM constant node (tag==5, t/f exit-lists both -1), used by constant folding to check both operands are foldable numbers.

name: luaK_dischargeVars
purpose: Lua luaK_dischargevars: resolves an expdesc's variable/indexed/call kind (VLOCAL/VUPVAL/VINDEXED/VCALL cases) into a relocatable register, emitting GETUPVAL/GETTABLE/self-op via luaK_code and swapping/patching its true/false jump lists through sub_10041140.

name: luaK_patchListToHere
purpose: Lua jump-list patcher walking a linked list of pending jump instructions (a2), calling luaK_fixjump (sub_1003FE50 with NO_JUMP=255) on each and following the next-link via sub_1003FE10 until -1.

name: luaK_codeArith
purpose: Lua luaK_codearith: attempts constant folding via sub_10041260, else frees both operand registers (luaK_exp2RK sub_10040980/sub_10040540 ordering by register index) and emits the arithmetic ABC opcode through luaK_code, marking the result expdesc VRELOCABLE.

name: luaK_constFold
purpose: Lua constfolding: given both operands are numeric constants, computes the ADD/SUB/MUL/DIV/MOD/POW/UNM result using floating-point ops (floor/pow, guarding division/mod by zero) and stores it back into the first expdesc's nval, returning success.

name: luaK_exp2anyreg
purpose: Lua expression-to-register dispatcher switching on expdesc kind: numeric/const kinds go through luaK_isNumericConst then luaK_exp2RK (sub_10040980), VCALL(6) via sub_100404F0, VRELOCABLE(13) via sub_10040CB0, VNONRELOC(14) via sub_10041480, else luaK_exp2RK.

name: luaK_exp2nextreg
purpose: Lua luaK_exp2nextreg: discharges an expdesc into the next free register — for VNIL/VTRUE emits LOADBOOL/LOADNIL (sub_1003FF70 with -1), VFALSE(2) reserves a reg via sub_1003FC50, VK(0xA) uses its info, default via luaK_dischargeanyreg (sub_10040DE0), then frees its false-list and marks -1.

name: luaK_posfix
purpose: Lua luaK_posfix binary-op finalizer switching on operator token: arithmetic ops(0-5) route to luaK_codeArith(ADD..POW opcodes 12-17), CONCAT(6) special-cases adjacent OP_CONCAT range merge in the code array or emits new, comparison ops(7-12) route to luaK_codeComp (sub_10041860 with EQ/LT/LE), AND(13)/OR(14) merge jump lists.

name: luaK_codeComp
purpose: Lua luaK_codecomp: emits a comparison opcode (EQ/LT/LE, a2) by resolving both operands to RK values (sub_10040980), freeing their registers, swapping operands and toggling the cond flag for the not-less/not-equal cases, then codes the ABC instruction via sub_10040E90 and marks result VJMP(10).

name: luaK_fixLine
purpose: Lua code helper writing value a2 into the lineinfo array (proto->lineinfo at *a1+20) at the last emitted instruction index (a1[6]-1), used to backpatch the source line of the just-generated opcode.

name: luaK_codeABx
purpose: Lua luaK_codeABx wrapper: packs opcode a2 with A(a3<<6) and Bx(a4<<23|a5<<14) fields into a 32-bit instruction and forwards to luaK_code (sub_10041960) with the current source line from the lexer state.

name: luaK_code
purpose: Lua luaK_code: flushes pending jump-target patches via sub_10041A40, grows the proto->code and proto->lineinfo arrays through luaM_growaux (sub_1004B630, MAX_INT limit, 'code size overflow' msg), stores the instruction and line, increments pc (a1[6]) and returns the instruction index.

name: luaK_dischargeJpc
purpose: Lua luaK_dischargejpc: patches the FuncState's pending jump-to-current list (jpc at +32) to the current pc via sub_1003FD20 with NO_JUMP=255, then resets jpc to -1.

name: luaK_codeABC
purpose: Lua luaK_codeABC wrapper: packs opcode a2 with A(a3<<6) and C(a4<<14) fields and forwards to luaK_code with the current source line, emitting an ABC-format instruction.

name: luaK_setList
purpose: Lua luaK_setlist: emits OP_SETLIST(34) for table constructor initialization computing the batch index ((n-1)/LFIELDS_PER_FLUSH+1), and when the block count exceeds 511 stores the real count in a following extra-arg instruction word; updates freereg.

name: l_debugGetregistry
purpose: Lua debug.getregistry C function: pushes the registry pseudo-index table (LUA_REGISTRYINDEX -10000) onto the stack via sub_1003B480 and returns 1.

name: l_debugGetmetatable
purpose: Lua debug.getmetatable C function: checks arg count via luaL_checkany-style sub_1003D420, calls lua_getmetatable (sub_1003C1C0); if the object has no metatable pushes nil (sub_1003BBC0), returns 1.

name: l_debugSetmetatable
purpose: Lua debug.setmetatable C function: validates arg2 is nil or table (luaL_argcheck via sub_1003CFC0 'nil or table expected'), sets top to arg2 (sub_1003B090), and calls lua_setmetatable (sub_1003BEF0) on arg1, returning 1.

name: l_debugGetfenv
purpose: Lua debug.getfenv C function: calls luaL_checkany (sub_1003C270) then lua_getfenv (sub_1003C270 path) pushing the object's environment table, returning 1.

name: l_debugSetfenv
purpose: Lua debug.setfenv C function: type-checks arg2 as a table (sub_1003D3C0 tag 5=LUA_TTABLE), sets stack top (sub_1003B090), and calls lua_setfenv (sub_1003C690); errors 'setfenv cannot change environment of given object' via sub_1003D170 on failure, returns 1.

name: l_debugGetinfo
purpose: Lua debug.getinfo C function: parses the optional thread arg (sub_10041FC0), the function/level arg and the 'flnStu' option string (sub_1003D490), calls lua_getinfo via ar-fetching sub_10042BF0/sub_10042ED0, then builds the result table populating source/short_src/linedefined/currentline/nups/name/namewhat/activelines/func fields with sub_10041F60/sub_10041F90.

name: l_debugSetinfoStrField
purpose: Lua debug.getinfo helper: pushes a C string value (lua_pushstring sub_1003BCE0) and sets it as named field a2 of the result table at stack index -2 (lua_setfield sub_1003C390).

name: l_debugSetinfoIntField
purpose: Lua debug.getinfo helper: pushes an integer value (lua_pushinteger sub_1003BC30) and sets it as named field a2 of the result table at index -2 (lua_setfield sub_1003C390).

name: l_debugGetThreadArg
purpose: Lua debug library helper: if arg1 is a thread (lua_isthread type 8 via sub_1003B4E0) sets *a2=1 and returns that thread's lua_State (lua_tothread sub_1003BAF0), else sets *a2=0 and returns the current state, giving the arg-index offset for optional thread parameter.

name: l_debugSetinfoTableField
purpose: Lua debug.getinfo helper for 'L'/'f' options: when source and target states differ transfers the pushed value across via lua_xmove (sub_1003AF20), otherwise reorders the stack (sub_1003B480/sub_1003B100), then sets it as named field a3 of the result table (lua_setfield sub_1003C390).

name: l_debugGetlocal
purpose: Lua debug.getlocal C function: parses optional thread arg (sub_10041FC0), fetches the stack level's activation record via lua_getstack (sub_10042BF0, 'level out of range'), then lua_getlocal (sub_10042CA0) pushing the local's value and returning its name plus value (2) or nil (1).

name: l_debugSetlocal
purpose: Lua debug.setlocal C function: parses optional thread arg, fetches the activation record via lua_getstack (sub_10042BF0, 'level out of range'), moves the new value across states (lua_xmove sub_1003AF20) and calls lua_setlocal (sub_10042E40), pushing the local variable's name.

name: l_debugGetupvalue
purpose: Lua debug.getupvalue C function: thin wrapper calling the shared upvalue accessor sub_10042250 with get-mode flag 1.

name: l_debugUpvalueAccess
purpose: Lua debug.get/setupvalue shared implementation: reads the upvalue index (luaL_checkint sub_1003D5A0), type-checks arg1 is a function (sub_1003D3C0 tag 6=LUA_TFUNCTION), then calls lua_getupvalue(sub_1003CDC0) or lua_setupvalue(sub_1003CEF0) by the a2 mode flag, pushing the upvalue name and (for get) its value.

name: l_debugSetupvalue
purpose: Lua debug.setupvalue C function: enforces the value argument exists (luaL_checkany sub_1003D420 on arg3) then delegates to the shared upvalue accessor sub_10042250 with set-mode flag 0.

name: l_debugSethook
purpose: Lua debug.sethook C function: parses optional thread arg, when a hook function is given reads the mask string and count (sub_1003D5F0), computes the event mask via sub_10042510, installs the C hook trampoline sub_10042460 and stores the Lua hook function in the registry keyed by thread (lua_sethook sub_10042B70); clears the hook when no function.

name: l_debugHookTrampoline
purpose: Lua debug hook C trampoline: on each hook event fetches the stored Lua hook function from the registry table (via unk_10066B58 key, LUA_REGISTRYINDEX -10000), pushes the event-name string (off_10066B5C[event]) and current line, and calls it via lua_call (sub_1003C780) with 2 args.

name: l_debugMakeHookMask
purpose: Lua debug.sethook helper translating the 'crl' mask string plus a count>0 into the numeric hook-event bitmask (LUA_MASKCALL=1 for 'c', LUA_MASKRET=2 for 'r', LUA_MASKLINE=4 for 'l', LUA_MASKCOUNT=8 when count>0).

name: l_debugGetHookTable
purpose: Lua debug hook helper: fetches (or lazily creates as a weak table) the registry sub-table (key unk_10066B58) that maps threads to their stored Lua hook functions, leaving it on the stack.

name: l_debugGethook
purpose: Lua debug.gethook C function: reads the current C hook pointer (sub_10042BC0) and count/mask (sub_10042BD0/sub_10042BE0); if it is the standard trampoline sub_10042460 retrieves the stored Lua function from the hook table, else pushes the literal string 'external hook', then pushes the mask string and count (3 results).

name: l_debugUnmakeHookMask
purpose: Lua debug.gethook helper converting the numeric hook-event bitmask back into the 'crl' string (bit1->'c', bit2->'r', bit4->'l') written into the caller buffer a2.

name: l_debugDebug
purpose: Lua debug.debug C function: runs an interactive REPL loop reading lines from stdin (fgets), until 'cont', compiling each via luaL_loadbuffer (sub_1003E300) and running with lua_pcall (sub_1003C7E0), printing errors from lua_tostring to stderr (_iob_func/fputs).

name: l_debugTraceback
purpose: Lua debug.traceback C function: builds a stack traceback string by iterating activation records via lua_getstack (sub_10042BF0) and lua_getinfo 'Snl' (sub_10042ED0), formatting each frame's short_src:currentline plus function name/main-chunk/C-function/<src:line> descriptors with lua_pushfstring (sub_1003BD70), collapsing deep middles with '...'.

name: luaopen_debug
purpose: Lua luaopen_debug: registers the 'debug' library table with its C-function array off_10066B70 (getinfo/sethook/traceback/getlocal/setlocal/getupvalue/setupvalue/getfenv/setfenv/getmetatable/setmetatable/getregistry/debug/gethook) via luaL_register (sub_1003D730), returns 1.

name: lua_setHook
purpose: Lua lua_sethook core: stores the C hook function pointer at lua_State+68, the count at +60/+64 and the event mask byte at +56 (clearing all when func or mask is empty), returning 1.

name: lua_getStack
purpose: Lua lua_getstack: walks down the CallInfo array from ci-top toward ci-base (a1+20 to a1+40, stride 24) decrementing the requested level (accounting for tail calls via the isLua flag at proto+6 and nresults +20), storing the resolved CallInfo index into the ar (a3+96), returning success.

name: lua_getLocal
purpose: Lua lua_getlocal: resolves the CallInfo from ar->i_ci (base_ci+24*ar[96]), calls the local-name lookup sub_10042D00, and on success pushes a copy of the local variable's stack slot value (base + 16*(n-1)) via sub_1003AE30.

name: lua_findLocalName
purpose: Lua getobjname/luaF_getlocalname helper: for a Lua function CallInfo, looks up the local variable name from the proto's debug locvars via sub_100461C0 using the current pc (sub_10042DA0), else returns the literal '(*temporary)' if the slot index is within the active stack range, or nil.

name: lua_currentPc
purpose: Lua currentpc: returns the current program-counter (instruction index) for a Lua CallInfo by differencing savedpc against the proto's code base ((savedpc - code)>>2 - 1), refreshing savedpc from L->savedpc for the top frame, or -1 for C functions.

name: lua_ciFuncProto
purpose: Lua helper returning the Proto pointer for a CallInfo when its function is a Lua closure (type 6, not C), reading closure->p at +16, else 0.

name: lua_setLocal
purpose: Lua lua_setlocal: resolves the CallInfo from ar->i_ci, looks up the local name via sub_10042D00, and on success pops the top stack value (L->top-16) copying its TValue into the local's stack slot (base+16*(n-1)), decrementing top; returns the name.

name: lua_getInfo
purpose: Lua lua_getinfo: fills a lua_Debug record for the requested option string — '>' pops the function off the stack, else uses the CallInfo; via auxgetinfo (sub_100430F0) populates S/l/u/n fields, and for 'f' pushes the function value and for 'L' pushes the active-lines table (sub_10043000).

name: lua_collectActiveLines
purpose: Lua getinfo 'L' handler: for a Lua function builds a new table (sub_10054720) whose keys are the line numbers from the proto's lineinfo array (proto+16, count at +48), setting each to true (sub_10054F10), pushing it; pushes nil for C functions.

name: luaG_getfuncname_helper
purpose: Parses the C-side symbex getobjname opcode-mode string ('L'/'S'/'l'/'n'/'u') for a Lua Proto, filling a name-info struct via sub_100432C0/sub_10043260/sub_10043C40 (getcurrentline, getobjname) to derive a function/local name for a debug traceback.

name: luaG_currentpc
purpose: Computes the current Lua VM program counter for a CallInfo by calling sub_10042DA0 (currentpc) then indexing the Proto's lineinfo array at [Proto+16]->[+20] to return the source line, else 0.

name: luaG_getfuncsource
purpose: Fills a debug ar struct's what/source/linedefined/lastlinedefined fields from a CallInfo: for C functions writes '[C]'/'=[C]', else reads Proto source at [Proto+32]+16 and line bounds at [+60]/[+64], copying the short source via sub_1004CF20 (luaO_chunkid).

name: luaG_getfuncinfoTail
purpose: Initializes a debug ar struct for the tail-call placeholder frame, setting what/namewhat to '(tail)'/'tail' and line fields to -1, copying '=(tail call)' short source via sub_1004CF20 (luaO_chunkid).

name: luaG_isJumpToClose
purpose: Bit-tests a Lua instruction: returns true when its opcode (word & 0x3F) is in {0x1C,0x1D,0x1E,0x22} and field A (word>>23) is 0, used by symbolic bytecode verification to detect close/setlist patterns.

name: luaG_checkcode
purpose: Thin entry to the Lua bytecode verifier sub_10043450 (luaG_symbexec) over the whole Proto (sizecode at [+44], reg 255), returning whether the code is well-formed.

name: luaG_symbexec
purpose: Lua 5.1 symbolic bytecode verifier: walks a Proto's instruction array validating each opcode's register/constant/upvalue operands against the opmode table byte_1006709C and Proto limits (maxstacksize [+75], numparams [+72], sizek/sizep), returning the last instruction that writes register reg or 0 on malformed code.

name: luaG_checkProtoHeader
purpose: Pre-verification sanity check on a Proto: validates maxstacksize<=250, numparams+vararg fits stacksize, vararg flag consistency, upvalue count, lineinfo size matches sizecode, and that the final opcode is RETURN (0x1E).

name: luaG_checkReg
purpose: Validates a Lua instruction operand by mode: mode 0 requires the value be 0, mode 2 requires reg < maxstacksize, mode 3 requires a register or RK constant index be in range, returning 0 if out of bounds.

name: luaG_isinstack
purpose: For a runtime error frame, checks the preceding CallInfo's instruction (via sub_10042DA0 currentpc) is a CALL/TAILCALL/TFORLOOP (0x1C/0x1D/0x21) and delegates to sub_10043D10 (getobjname) to name the object in register A of that call.

name: luaG_getobjname
purpose: Resolves a human-readable name+namewhat for a register in a Proto by inspecting the last instruction that set it (via luaG_symbexec): handles MOVE (recurse), GETUPVAL('upvalue'), GETGLOBAL('global'), GETTABLE/SELF ('field'/'method') reading upvalue/global/constant tables of the Proto.

name: luaG_kname
purpose: Returns the string name of a Lua constant referenced by an RK operand: if the RK bit (0x100) is set and the constant slot type is LUA_TSTRING (4), returns the TString body at const+16, else '?'.

name: luaG_typeerror
purpose: Raises a Lua runtime type error (noreturn): looks up the type name via off_10067270, if the bad value is on the current stack calls luaG_getobjname (sub_10043D10) to name it, then formats 'attempt to %s %s '%s' (a %s value)' through sub_10044220 (luaG_runerror).

name: luaG_isinstackRange
purpose: Scans the current CallInfo stack window [*a1, a1[2]) in 16-byte TValue strides to test whether pointer a2 lies within the live stack, used to decide if a bad value can be named.

name: luaG_concaterror
purpose: Raises a Lua concat type error (noreturn): picks whichever operand is not a string/number (type 4/3) and forwards it to luaG_typeerror (sub_10043F50) with the 'concatenate' verb.

name: luaG_aritherror
purpose: Raises a Lua arithmetic type error (noreturn): calls sub_100576F0 (luaV_tonumber) on the operand and, if it is non-numeric, forwards it to luaG_typeerror (sub_10043F50) with 'perform arithmetic on'.

name: luaG_ordererror
purpose: Raises a Lua comparison error (noreturn): fetches both operand type names via off_10067270 and formats either 'attempt to compare two %s values' or 'attempt to compare %s with %s' through luaG_runerror (sub_10044220).

name: luaD_callErrorHandler
purpose: On a Lua error, if an __ERRORMESSAGE handler global exists it pushes it plus the error object onto the stack, grows the stack (sub_100447B0) and calls it via luaD_call (sub_10045110), then throws via luaD_throw (sub_100443E0) with status 2.

name: luaG_runerror
purpose: Formats a Lua runtime error message (varargs) via sub_1004CB40 (luaO_pushvfstring), prepends source:line via sub_10044270, then unwinds through luaD_callErrorHandler (sub_10044130) — noreturn.

name: luaG_addinfo
purpose: Prepends 'source:line: ' location info to the error string on the stack top: reads the running Lua Proto's short source (via luaO_chunkid sub_1004CF20) and current line (luaG_currentpc sub_10043260) and formats via sub_1004CEE0 (luaO_pushfstring).

name: luaD_seterrorobj
purpose: Sets the error object at the given stack slot per status code: MEM/ERR push interned 'not enough memory'/'error in error handling' strings via sub_100516B0 (luaS_newlstr), RUN/SYNTAX copy the existing top TValue, then adjusts the stack top.

name: luaD_throw
purpose: Throws a Lua error (noreturn): if an error-jump buf is set stores the status and longjmps, else records the status in the lua_State, invokes the global panic function [G+88] and calls exit(1).

name: luaD_reset
purpose: Resets the lua_State to the base CallInfo after an error: restores ci/base/top, calls luaF_close (sub_10045EC0) to close upvalues, sets the error object (luaD_seterrorobj sub_10044310), restores nCcalls and shrinks the CI array via sub_100444D0.

name: luaD_shrinkCI
purpose: Shrinks the oversized CallInfo array back toward LUAI_MAXCALLS (20000) when nci exceeds it, recomputing the used slot count and calling luaD_reallocCI (sub_10044700).

name: luaD_rawrunprotected
purpose: Runs a function under a protected setjmp3 error barrier: chains a lua_longjmp buf into the lua_State [+112], executes the callback, and returns the caught status code (0 if no error).

name: luaD_reallocstack
purpose: Reallocates the Lua value stack to newsize+EXTRA via sub_1004B700 (luaM_realloc), guarding against overflow (>0xFFFFFFF) with luaD_growError (sub_1004B6E0), then fixes all stack pointers via luaD_correctstack (sub_10044610).

name: luaD_correctstack
purpose: After a stack reallocation, relocates top, all open upvalues (list at [+26]), every CallInfo's base/func/top fields, and the savedpc-relative pointers to the newly moved stack base at [+8].

name: luaD_reallocCI
purpose: Reallocates the CallInfo array to newsize entries (24 bytes each) via sub_1004B700 (luaM_realloc), overflow-guarded by luaD_growError, then repoints ci and end_ci into the moved array.

name: luaD_growstack
purpose: Grows the Lua value stack by at least n slots, choosing between doubling and current+n, and delegating to luaD_reallocstack (sub_10044570).

name: luaD_callhook
purpose: Invokes the registered Lua debug hook: saves/restores stack top and ci top, builds a lua_Debug (event, currentline) in a local, temporarily blocks reentrant hooks via the allowhook byte [+57], and calls the hook function pointer at [+68].

name: luaD_precall
purpose: Prepares a Lua function call: for C functions grows the stack, sets up a new CallInfo and directly invokes the C function pointer then luaD_poscall (sub_10044F90); for Lua closures adjusts varargs (luaD_adjustvarargs sub_10044C90), opens a CallInfo, zeroes locals, sets savedpc/base and fires the call hook.

name: luaD_growCI
purpose: Grows the CallInfo array when a new frame is needed: throws error status 5 if already at the hard limit, doubles via luaD_reallocCI (sub_10044700), raises 'stack overflow' via luaG_runerror if still over 20000, then advances and returns the new ci.

name: luaD_adjustvarargs
purpose: Adjusts the stack for a vararg Lua function: pads missing fixed params with nil, and when the function has the newstyle vararg flag (0x4) builds an 'arg' table (luaH_new sub_10054720) populated with extra args plus an 'n' field, then moves fixed params into place.

name: luaD_tryfuncTM
purpose: Handles calling a non-function value: fetches the __call metamethod via sub_10055C90 (luaT_gettmbyobj), errors via luaG_typeerror (sub_10043F50) if absent, then shifts stack values up by one slot to insert the metamethod as the new callee.

name: luaD_poscall
purpose: Finalizes a returning Lua function: fires the return hook (sub_10045090) if hooks are active, pops the CallInfo, restores caller base/savedpc, and moves the results down to the function slot padding with nil to the expected result count.

name: luaD_callReturnHooks
purpose: Fires the LUA_HOOKRET return hook via luaD_callhook (sub_100447F0) and, for a Lua caller still in tail-call chains (flag 0x2), repeatedly fires LUA_HOOKTAILRET (event 4) decrementing the tailcall counter.

name: luaD_call
purpose: Core Lua call driver: increments/decrements the nCcalls C-stack depth guard (errors 'C stack overflow' at 200, throws at 225), runs luaD_precall (sub_10044900) and if it started a Lua frame executes luaV_execute (sub_100584A0), then checks GC threshold via luaC_checkGC (sub_10046780).

name: lua_resume
purpose: Resumes a Lua coroutine: validates the thread is suspended/fresh (else errors 'cannot resume'), guards C-stack depth, runs the resume body sub_100452D0 under luaD_rawrunprotected (sub_10044520), and on error sets the status byte and error object.

name: lua_resumeInner
purpose: The protected body of a coroutine resume: on first resume runs luaD_precall (sub_10044900), on a resumed yield finishes the pending C-call via luaD_poscall (sub_10044F90) or continues the Lua frame, then runs luaV_execute (sub_100584A0).

name: lua_resumeError
purpose: Helper that pushes a resume-failure error string (interned via luaS_newlstr sub_100516B0) onto the coroutine stack, growing it if needed, and returns status 2 (LUA_ERRRUN).

name: lua_yield
purpose: Implements lua_yield: errors 'attempt to yield across metamethod/C-call boundary' if nesting depth mismatches, sets the frame base for nresults, marks the thread status yielded (byte [+6]=1) and returns -1.

name: luaD_pcall
purpose: Runs a function in fully protected mode: saves ci/allowhook/errfunc, runs the callback under luaD_rawrunprotected (sub_10044520), and on error restores the saved state, closes upvalues via luaF_close (sub_10045EC0) and sets the error object (luaD_seterrorobj).

name: luaD_protectedparser
purpose: Wraps the Lua parser/loader in luaD_pcall (sub_10045450) via the SParser closure sub_100455C0, then frees the loader buffer through luaM_realloc (sub_1004B700) and returns the parse status.

name: luaD_fparser
purpose: The protected-parse body: peeks the first char of the input (sub_1005AAB0/zgetc) to dispatch to the binary undump (luaU_undump sub_10056CD0) or the text lexer/parser (luaY_parser sub_1004D9C0), then wraps the result Proto in a new LClosure with fresh upvalues and pushes it.

name: luaU_dump
purpose: Entry to Lua bytecode serialization: builds a DumpState (writer fn, data, strip flag) and calls sub_10045BE0 (DumpHeader) then sub_10045740 (DumpFunction) to serialize a Proto, returning the writer error status.

name: luaU_dumpFunction
purpose: Serializes one Lua Proto: dumps source string, line-defined bounds, the nups/numparams/is_vararg/maxstacksize bytes, the code array via sub_100458B0, then nested constants (sub_10045950) and debug info (sub_10045A90).

name: luaU_dumpChar
purpose: Serializes a single byte to the dump stream by staging it on the stack and calling luaU_dumpBlock (sub_10045850).

name: luaU_dumpBlock
purpose: Writes a raw block to the bytecode dump via the DumpState writer callback [+4], short-circuiting once a prior write error status [+16] is recorded.

name: luaU_dumpInt
purpose: ldump.c DumpInt helper: takes a 4-byte int by address and writes it to the dump sink via the writer sub_10045850(buf,4,DumpState).

name: luaU_dumpVector
purpose: ldump.c DumpVector: dumps an array by first writing the element count via luaU_dumpInt then writing size*n bytes through the block writer sub_10045850.

name: luaU_dumpString
purpose: ldump.c DumpString: writes TString length (getstr size+1 at obj+12, or 0 when NULL/sentinel) via sub_10045850 then the string body at obj+16.

name: luaU_dumpConstants
purpose: ldump.c DumpConstants: dumps a Proto's constant array (k) tag-switching on TValue type (1=bool/int, 3=number via luaU_dumpNumber, 4=string) then recurses over nested protos (p) via sub_10045740.

name: luaU_dumpNumber
purpose: ldump.c DumpNumber: writes an 8-byte lua_Number (double) taken by address to the dump sink via the block writer sub_10045850(buf,8,DumpState).

name: luaU_dumpDebug
purpose: ldump.c DumpDebug/DumpFunction tail: dumps a Proto's line-info vector, locvars (name+startpc+endpc triples) and upvalue name array, zeroing counts when DumpState strip flag at +12 is set.

name: luaU_dumpHeader
purpose: ldump.c DumpHeader: builds the 12-byte Lua bytecode signature/header block via luaU_header (sub_10057640) and writes it through sub_10045850.

name: luaH_newHashPart
purpose: lgc/ltable helper: allocates a GC hash-part node array (size 16*(n-1)+40) via luaM_realloc_ (sub_1004B700), links it into the GC root list via luaC_link (sub_10047B70) with type tag 6, and stores capacity/flags at obj+6/+7/+12.

name: luaH_newArrayPart
purpose: ltable helper: allocates a GC array-part block (size 4*n+20) via luaM_realloc_, links it into GC via luaC_link tag 6, zeroes the n slots, and records array-flag/count at obj+6/+7.

name: luaS_newUdata
purpose: lstring/lgc helper: allocates a 32-byte Udata/collectible via luaM_realloc_, links it via luaC_link tag 10, and self-initializes its embedded metatable pointer at obj+8.

name: luaC_newGCObjWithColor
purpose: lgc allocator: walks the fixed GC list at obj+104 to insert/find an object keyed on size (obj+8), allocating 32 bytes via luaM_realloc_ and painting it currentwhite (g+20 &3) or toggling its white bit to keep the invariant.

name: luaM_freeUdata
purpose: lgc sweep helper: if a Udata's metatable/env pointer at +8 differs from its embedded default, unlinks it via luaE_unlink (sub_10045E90) before freeing the 32-byte object through luaM_realloc_(o,32,0).

name: luaE_unlinkNode
purpose: lgc/lstate helper: unlinks a doubly-linked GC node by patching the prev node's next (prev+16) and the next node's prev (next+20) pointers.

name: luaC_freeAll
purpose: lgc: drains the fixed/collectible list at g+104, freeing objects whose white differs from currentwhite via luaM_freeUdata, else relinking survivors and re-registering them via luaC_reallocIndex (sub_10047BB0).

name: luaF_newProto
purpose: lfunc.c luaF_newproto: allocates a 76-byte Proto via luaM_realloc_, links it into GC via luaC_link tag 9, and zeroes all Proto fields (code/k/p/lineinfo/locvars/upvalues pointers and their counts).

name: luaF_freeProto
purpose: lfunc.c luaF_freeproto: frees a Proto's six sub-arrays (code, p, k, lineinfo, locvars, upvalues) sized by their respective counts via luaM_realloc_ then frees the 76-byte Proto itself.

name: luaH_freeTablePart
purpose: ltable helper: frees a table array/hash part, computing the byte size from the array-vs-hash flag at obj+6 and count at obj+7 (16*(n-1)+40 or 4*n+20), via luaM_realloc_.

name: luaG_getFuncLine
purpose: ldebug helper: scans a Proto's locvars/line-mapping table (g+24, count g+56) to return the address of the nth active local variable info entry covering pc a3.

name: luaC_separateUdata
purpose: lgc luaC_separateudata: walks the tmudata/finalizer list at g+112, moving userdata with __gc metamethods (probed via luaT_gettm sub_10055C40 event 2) onto the tobefinalized list at g+48 and returning their total size.

name: luaC_callAllGCTM
purpose: lgc luaC_callGCTM loop: repeatedly drains the tobefinalized list at g+48 by calling luaC_callOneGCTM (sub_100463A0) until empty.

name: luaC_callOneGCTM
purpose: lgc GCTM: pops one userdata from the finalize list (g+48), relinks it into rootgc (g+112), fetches its __gc metamethod via luaT_gettm (sub_10055C40 event 2), pushes udata+closure onto the stack and invokes luaD_call (sub_10045110) with GC threshold temporarily maxed.

name: luaC_markRoots
purpose: lgc markroot: sets gcstate to propagate (g+20=67), then reallymarks the main thread/global table root at g+28 and the registry/stack roots at g[0..count] via reallymark (sub_100465A0).

name: luaC_sweepList
purpose: lgc sweeplist: walks a GC object list up to count a3, recursing into open-upvalue lists for thread objects (type 8), keeping live objects by repainting them currentwhite and freeing dead ones via luaC_freeObject (sub_10046680).

name: luaC_freeObject
purpose: lgc freeobj: type-dispatches on the GC tag at obj+4 to the correct destructor (4=string luaM free, 5=luaH_free, 6=table-part free, 7=upvalue free, 8=luaE_freethread, 9=luaF_freeproto, 10=luaF_freeudata).

name: luaC_step
purpose: lgc luaC_step: runs one incremental GC slice budgeted by g[84]*10, repeatedly calling singlestep (sub_10046860) and recomputing the GCthreshold/GCdebt at g+64/+76 from estimate and gcpause/gcstepmul (g+68..84).

name: luaC_singleStep
purpose: lgc singlestep: the incremental GC state machine dispatching on gcstate at g+21 (0=pause→markroot, 1=propagate via propagatemark sub_10046A10, 2=sweepstring, 3=sweep, 4=finalize) and returning the work-unit cost of the step.

name: luaC_propagateMark
purpose: lgc propagatemark: pops the gray object at g+36 and traverses it per type tag (5=table via sub_10046BF0, 6=closure via traverseclosure sub_100471C0, 8=thread via traversestack sub_100472D0, 9=proto via sub_10047020), returning traversal cost.

name: luaC_traverseTable
purpose: lgc traversetable: marks a table's metatable/keys/values, reading the __mode metamethod string (sub_10055C40 event 3) for 'k'/'v' weakness via strchr, links weak tables onto g+44, and clears dead array entries otherwise.

name: luaC_removeCollectedKey
purpose: lgc helper: marks a table hash node's key as dead/removed by setting its type tag at node+24 to LUA_TDEADKEY (11) when it was a collectible (>=4).

name: luaC_reallyMark
purpose: lgc reallymark: clears an object's white bits (obj+5 &=~3) and type-dispatches on tag obj+4 to gray it — recursing strings, pushing tables/protos/threads onto the gray list at g+36, and greying upvalue/closure references.

name: luaC_traverseProto
