name: numusearray
purpose: Lua ltable.c numusearray: counts non-nil entries in the table's array part per power-of-two bucket by scanning array slots (TValue at *(a1+12)+16*(i-1)+8) up to sizearray (*(a1+28)), accumulating into the histogram and returning the total.

name: numusehash
purpose: Lua ltable.c numusehash: iterates the table's hash part (node array at *(a1+16), 2^lsizenode entries from a1+7) and for each non-nil value calls countint (sub_10054D10) to bucket integer keys, returning the count of used hash nodes.

name: getFreePos
purpose: Lua ltable.c getfreepos: decrements the table's lastfree pointer (*(a1+20)) walking backward through the node array until it finds a node with a nil key (offset +24) or exhausts the range, returning that free node or 0.

name: luaH_setnum
purpose: Lua ltable.c luaH_setnum: looks up integer key via luaH_getnum (sub_10054820); if it resolves to luaO_nilobject (&unk_10066EF0), builds a TValue number key (tag 3) and inserts it via luaH_newkey (sub_10054A50), else returns the existing value slot.

name: luaH_setstr
purpose: Lua ltable.c luaH_setstr: looks up a string key via luaH_getstr (sub_100548A0); if it resolves to luaO_nilobject (&unk_10066EF0), builds a TValue string key (tag 4) and inserts it via luaH_newkey (sub_10054A50), else returns the existing value slot.

name: luaH_getn
purpose: Lua ltable.c luaH_getn: computes the table border/length by checking the last array slot, doing a binary search over the array part for a nil boundary, or delegating to unbound_search (sub_10055070) when the array is full and a hash part exists, honoring the dummynode &unk_10067200.

name: unbound_search
purpose: Lua ltable.c unbound_search: finds a table border by exponentially doubling the probe index (via luaH_getnum, sub_10054820) until a nil is found, then binary-searching between bounds, with an overflow linear scan when the index exceeds 0x7FFFFFFD.

name: l_tableForeachi
purpose: Lua ltablib.c luaB_foreachi: iterates a table numerically from 1 to lua_objlen (sub_1003B9A0), for each index pushing the function, index and rawgeti'd value (sub_1003C0E0) and calling it (sub_1003C780/lua_call), returning early if the callback returns non-nil.

name: l_tableForeach
purpose: Lua ltablib.c luaB_foreach: iterates a table via lua_next (sub_1003CBD0) after luaL_checktype table/function, calling the callback with key,value for each pair (lua_call sub_1003C780), returning early when the callback yields non-nil.

name: l_tableMaxn
purpose: Lua ltablib.c luaB_maxn: iterates the table with lua_next (sub_1003CBD0) tracking the largest numeric key (lua_type==3 via sub_1003B4E0, lua_tonumber sub_1003B800) and pushes the maximum via lua_pushnumber (sub_1003BBF0).

name: l_tableGetn
purpose: Lua ltablib.c luaB_getn (deprecated table.getn): checks a table arg and pushes its length from lua_objlen (sub_1003B9A0) via lua_pushinteger (sub_1003BC30).

name: l_tableSetn
purpose: Lua ltablib.c luaB_setn (obsolete table.setn stub): checks a table arg then raises a Lua error via luaL_error (sub_1003D170) with the message 'setn is obsolete'.

name: l_tableInsert
purpose: Lua ltablib.c luaB_tinsert (table.insert): checks arg count (lua_gettop sub_1003B070); with 2 args appends at pos len+1 (lua_rawseti sub_1003C4D0), with 3 args shifts elements up from the insertion index (rawgeti/rawseti loop) then stores, else raises 'wrong number of arguments'.

name: l_tableRemove
purpose: Lua ltablib.c luaB_tremove (table.remove): reads the removal position (luaL_optinteger sub_1003D5F0) and object length, shifts subsequent elements down via rawgeti/rawseti (sub_1003C0E0/sub_1003C4D0), pushes the removed value and nils the last slot.

name: l_tableConcat
purpose: Lua ltablib.c luaB_concat (table.concat): reads separator (luaL_optlstring sub_1003D490) and range bounds, initializes a luaL_Buffer (sub_1003DDC0), appends each element's string (sub_100556B0) separated by the separator (luaL_addlstring sub_1003DC40), and pushes the result via luaL_pushresult (sub_1003DCD0).

name: tableConcatAddField
purpose: Lua ltablib.c addfield helper for table.concat: rawgeti's element i (sub_1003C0E0), errors via luaL_error (sub_1003D170) 'invalid value at index' if it is not a string/number, then appends it to the luaL_Buffer via luaL_addvalue (sub_1003DD10).

name: l_tableSort
purpose: Lua ltablib.c luaB_sort (table.sort): checks the table and optional comparator (luaL_checktype), reads length via lua_objlen (sub_1003B9A0), and invokes the recursive quicksort auxsort (sub_100557A0) over the range 1..n.

name: tableSortAuxsort
purpose: Lua ltablib.c auxsort: recursive quicksort over a Lua array using rawgeti (sub_1003C0E0) to fetch pivots, sort_comp (sub_10055AF0) to compare, set2 (sub_10055AC0) to swap, partitioning and recursing on the smaller half to bound stack depth, raising 'invalid order function' on inconsistent comparators.

name: tableSortSet2
purpose: Lua ltablib.c set2: stores the two stack values into table array slots a2 and a3 via lua_rawseti (sub_1003C4D0), implementing an element swap for table.sort.

name: tableSortCompare
purpose: Lua ltablib.c sort_comp: compares two stack values, using lua_lessthan (sub_1003B790) when no comparator was supplied, otherwise pushing the comparator function and both operands and lua_call'ing it (sub_1003C780) and reading the boolean result (lua_toboolean sub_1003B8B0).

name: luaopen_table
purpose: Lua ltablib.c luaopen_table: registers the 'table' library table (off_10067220 luaL_Reg array) into the global environment via luaL_register (sub_1003D730) and returns 1.

name: luaT_init
purpose: Lua ltm.c luaT_init: interns the 17 metamethod event name strings (off_100672A0 array) via luaS_newlstr (sub_100516B0), stores them in G(L)->tmname (*(a1+16)+188), and marks each TString fixed by ORing 0x20 into its marked byte.

name: luaT_gettm
purpose: Lua ltm.c luaT_gettm: fetches a metamethod from a metatable via luaH_getstr (sub_100548A0); if absent (nil value) it sets the corresponding flags bit (1<<event) in the table's flags byte (a1+6) to cache the negative result and returns null.

name: luaT_gettmbyobj
purpose: Lua ltm.c luaT_gettmbyobj: resolves the metatable for a value by its type tag (table type 5 and userdata type 7 read the object's own metatable at +8, others index G->mt at *(a1+16)+4*type+152), then looks up the event tmname (+188) via luaH_getstr (sub_100548A0), returning luaO_nilobject (&unk_10066EF0) if none.

name: luaMessage
purpose: Lua lua.c l_message: prints a program-name prefixed diagnostic to stderr (_iob_func()+2) via fprintf '%s: ' then '%s\n' and flushes, used by the standalone interpreter's error reporter.

name: luaReport
purpose: Lua lua.c report: if a call returned an error status and there is an error object on the stack, extracts its string (lua_tolstring sub_1003B900, defaulting to 'error object is not a string'), prints it via l_message (sub_10055DC0) and pops it.

name: luaPmain
purpose: Lua lua.c pmain: the standalone interpreter's protected main — stores argv, sets progname, opens libs (sub_10047C80/openlibs after luaL_checkversion-style guards), parses the command line via getargs (sub_100568E0/collectargs), runs -e/-l chunks (sub_10056AB0/runargs), the script (sub_10056700/handle_script), and drops into the REPL (sub_10056300/dotty) or reads stdin, using isatty/fileno to detect a terminal.

name: luaPrintUsage
purpose: Lua lua.c print_usage: writes the standalone interpreter's usage/help text (available -e/-l/-i/-v/-- options) to stderr via fprintf(_iob_func()+2,...) and flushes.

name: luaPrintVersion
purpose: Lua lua.c print_version: prints the 'Lua 5.1.4 Copyright' banner string to stderr via l_message (sub_10055DC0).

name: luaDofile
purpose: Lua lua.c dofile: loads a file via luaL_loadfile (sub_1003DF80) and if that succeeds runs it via docall (sub_10056120), passing the combined status to report (sub_10055E20).

name: luaDocall
purpose: Lua lua.c docall: sets a message-handler (traceback, sub_10056230) below the function, installs a SIGINT handler (signal(2,...) with laction) around lua_pcall (sub_1003C7E0), removes the handler, and on error runs a full GC (lua_gc sub_1003CA70).

name: luaLstop
purpose: Lua lua.c lstop: SIGINT debug-hook that clears the hook via lua_sethook (sub_10042B70) and raises luaL_error (sub_1003D170) 'interrupted!' to abort the running chunk.

name: luaTraceback
purpose: Lua lua.c traceback message-handler: for a string error object, fetches debug.traceback from the loaded-table registry (lua_getfield sub_1003C000 on 'debug'/'traceback') and calls it (lua_call sub_1003C780) to append a stack trace, otherwise leaves the message unchanged.

name: luaDotty
purpose: Lua lua.c dotty: the interactive REPL loop — reads a complete line via loadline (sub_10056440), docall's it (sub_10056120), reports errors, and if the result has values calls the global 'print' (lua_getfield sub_1003C000 / lua_pcall sub_1003C7E0) to echo them, restoring progname on exit.

name: luaLoadline
purpose: Lua lua.c loadline: reads a REPL line via pushline (sub_10056580), then repeatedly tries to compile it (luaL_loadbuffer sub_1003E300) and while incomplete (sub_10056520) appends further input lines, concatenating (lua_concat sub_1003CC40) into a full chunk.

name: luaIncomplete
purpose: Lua lua.c incomplete: after a failed load, inspects the error message (lua_tolstring sub_1003B900) for the '<eof>' marker (strstr against SubStr) to decide whether the chunk is merely incomplete and more input is needed, popping the message if so.

name: luaPushline
purpose: Lua lua.c pushline: writes the prompt (get_prompt sub_10056680) to stdout, reads up to 512 bytes via fgets from _iob_func(), strips the trailing newline, and pushes the line as a Lua string (prefixing 'return ' via lua_pushfstring sub_1003BD70 when it begins with '=').

name: luaGetPrompt
purpose: Lua lua.c get_prompt: fetches the global _PROMPT or _PROMPT2 (lua_getfield sub_1003C000 on -10002/globals), returning the string (lua_tolstring sub_1003B900) or the default '> '/'>> ' constants, then pops it.

name: luaHandleScript
purpose: Lua lua.c handle_script: builds the 'arg' table from argv (getargs sub_100567F0), loads the script file (luaL_loadfile sub_1003DF80, treating '-' as stdin), and on success runs it with the collected args via docall (sub_10056120), reporting the result.

name: luaGetargs
purpose: Lua lua.c getargs: constructs the global 'arg' table — counts argv entries, pushes pre-script args at negative indices and script args at 1..n via lua_rawseti (sub_1003C4D0) after creating the table (lua_createtable sub_1003C150), returning the script argument count.

name: luaCollectargs
purpose: Lua lua.c collectargs: scans argv for the standalone interpreter's option flags (-i,-v,-e,-l,--,-) via a switch on the second char, setting the has-i/has-v/has-e output flags and returning the script index or -1 on a bad option.

name: luaRunargs
purpose: Lua lua.c runargs: replays the -e (execute string via dostring sub_10056BB0) and -l (require library via dolibrary sub_10056C20) options in command-line order, consuming the following argv token when the flag has no attached value, returning 1 on the first failure.

name: luaDostring
purpose: Lua lua.c dostring: compiles a string chunk with luaL_loadbuffer (sub_1003E300) using a chunk name and runs it via docall (sub_10056120), reporting via report (sub_10055E20) — backs the -e command-line option.

name: luaDolibrary
purpose: Lua lua.c dolibrary: pushes the global 'require' function (lua_getfield sub_1003C000 on globals) and the module name string, calls it via docall (sub_10056120), and reports the result — backs the -l command-line option.

name: luaLoadInitFromEnv
purpose: lua_load helper that reads the LUA_INIT env var via getenv(), dispatching to a file loader (sub_100560C0) when it begins with '@' or otherwise to a string loader (sub_10056BB0) with chunkname "=LUA_INIT".

name: luaUndumpDriver
purpose: lua_load undump entrypoint that normalizes the chunk source name (stripping '@'/'=' prefix or substituting "binary string" for the escape byte), initializes the LoadState with the reader triple, verifies the bytecode header (sub_100575D0) and loads the top-level Proto via luaU_undump (sub_10056D60).

name: luaUndumpFunction
purpose: luaU_undump recursive Proto loader that bumps a nesting counter (error "code too deep" past 200), allocates a Proto via luaF_newproto, reads lineDefined/lastlinedefined ints, nups/numparams/is_vararg/maxstacksize bytes, then loads code, constants and debug via sub_10057080/110/390 and validates it with luaG_checkcode (sub_10043420).

name: luaUndumpError
purpose: __noreturn undump error reporter that formats "%s: %s in precompiled chunk" with the chunk name via luaO_pushfstring (sub_1004CEE0) and raises a LUA_ERRSYNTAX longjmp via luaD_throw (sub_100443E0).

name: luaUndumpByte
purpose: LoadByte helper reading one byte from the undump stream via LoadBlock (sub_10056F80) and returning it.

name: luaUndumpBlock
purpose: LoadBlock that pulls a3 bytes from the ZIO reader (luaZ_read sub_1005AB40) into a2 and raises "unexpected end" via luaUndumpError on short read.

name: luaUndumpInt
purpose: LoadInt helper reading a 4-byte int via LoadBlock and raising "bad integer" if negative.

name: luaUndumpString
purpose: LoadString that reads a size_t length then the bytes into a resized buffer (luaZ_openspace sub_1005ABE0) and interns them as a TString via luaS_newlstr (sub_100516B0), returning NULL for zero length.

name: luaUndumpCode
purpose: LoadCode reading an int instruction count (overflow-checked against MAX_INT/4), allocating the Proto code array via luaM_realloc_ (sub_1004B700), setting sizecode, and LoadVector-ing the 4-byte instructions.

name: luaUndumpConstants
purpose: LoadConstants reading the sizek TValue constant array (nil/bool/number via LoadNumber sub_10057370/string via LoadString, error "bad constant") and then the sizep nested Proto array via recursive luaU_undump (sub_10056D60).

name: luaUndumpNumber
purpose: LoadNumber helper reading an 8-byte lua_Number (double) from the undump stream via LoadBlock.

name: luaUndumpDebug
purpose: LoadDebug reading the Proto debug info — lineinfo int array (sizelineinfo), locvars array (varname string + startpc/endpc ints, sizelocvars), and upvalue name string array (sizeupvalues) — each allocated via luaM_realloc_ (sub_1004B700).

name: luaUndumpHeader
purpose: LoadHeader that builds the expected 12-byte Lua signature (sub_10057640), LoadBlock-reads the file header and memcmp's them, raising "bad header in precompiled chunk" on mismatch.

name: luaMakeHeader
purpose: luaU_header that writes the 12-byte bytecode signature block: "\033Lua", version 0x51, format 0, little-endian flag, sizes of int/size_t/Instruction/lua_Number (4/4/4/8) and the integral flag.

name: luaVToNumber
purpose: luaV_tonumber that returns the TValue if already a number, else if it is a string parses it via luaO_str2d (sub_1004CA90) into the scratch TValue and tags it LUA_TNUMBER, returning NULL on failure.

name: luaVToString
purpose: luaV_tostring that formats a number TValue with sprintf("%.14g") and interns the result as a TString via luaS_newlstr (sub_100516B0), converting the value in place to LUA_TSTRING.

name: luaVGetTable
purpose: luaV_gettable that performs indexed read with metamethod chaining up to 100 loops (error "loop in gettable"): on a table it does luaH_get (sub_10054900) and honors a raw hit or absent __index, otherwise fetches the __index metamethod via luaT_gettmbyobj, calling luaG_typeerror on non-indexable and dispatching function metamethods to sub_10057940.

name: luaCallTM3
purpose: callTMres helper that pushes the metamethod plus its two argument TValues onto the stack (growing via luaD_growstack sub_100447B0), invokes luaD_call (sub_10045110), then pops and copies the single result TValue back to the destination slot.

name: luaVSetTable
purpose: luaV_settable that performs indexed write with metamethod chaining up to 100 loops (error "loop in settable"): on a table with an existing slot or absent __newindex it luaH_set-writes (sub_100549C0) and runs the write barrier (luaC_barrierback sub_10047B20), otherwise dispatches the __newindex metamethod (function via sub_10057C00, table by re-looping).

name: luaCallTM4
purpose: callTM helper for __newindex that pushes the metamethod plus key/value TValues (three args) onto the stack, grows it via luaD_growstack (sub_100447B0), and invokes luaD_call (sub_10045110) with no results.

name: luaVLessThan
purpose: luaV_lessthan comparing two TValues: direct double/luaV_lessthan on numbers, l_strcmp (sub_10057EA0) on strings, otherwise the __lt metamethod via sub_10057DE0, raising luaG_ordererror (sub_100440C0) on type mismatch or missing metamethod.

name: luaVCallOrderTM
purpose: call_orderTM helper that fetches a comparison metamethod (event a4) from both operands via luaT_gettmbyobj (sub_10055C90), verifies they are the same object (luaO_rawequalObj sub_1004C9E0), invokes it via callTMres (sub_10057940), and returns the boolean result or -1 if absent.

name: luaStrcmp
purpose: l_strcmp performing collation-aware TString comparison via strcoll over embedded-NUL-delimited segments, falling back to length comparison to break ties.

name: luaVEqualVal
purpose: luaV_equalval that compares two same-type TValues by tag (nil, bool, lightuserdata, number, string pointer, table/userdata identity) and on tables/userdata with differing identity fetches the __eq metamethod via get_compTM (sub_100580F0) and invokes it via callTMres.

name: luaGetCompTM
purpose: get_compTM helper resolving a shared comparison metamethod (e.g. __eq) from two metatables via luaT_gettm (sub_10055C40), returning it only if both metatables define the identical event handler (luaO_rawequalObj).

name: luaVConcat

name: luaVConcatTM
purpose: concat metamethod dispatcher that fetches __concat via luaT_gettmbyobj (sub_10055C90) from either operand and invokes it through callTMres (sub_10057940), returning 0 when absent.

name: luaVExecute
purpose: luaV_execute — the 8.4 KB Lua 5.1 bytecode interpreter dispatch loop decoding OP_MOVE/LOADK/GETGLOBAL/GETTABLE/SETTABLE/ADD..POW/CONCAT/JMP/EQ/LT/LE/CALL/RETURN/FORLOOP/CLOSURE etc, driving luaV_gettable/settable, the arith metamethods (sub_1005A860), luaD_precall/poscall, luaH_new and closure creation over the CallInfo/base/savedpc state.

name: luaGTraceExec

name: luaVLessEqual
purpose: luaV_lessequal comparing two TValues via direct double/l_strcmp for numbers/strings, else trying the __le metamethod and falling back to a negated __lt (via sub_10057DE0 events 14 then 13), raising luaG_ordererror on missing metamethods.

name: luaArithMetamethod
purpose: luaV_arith/arith helper that coerces both operands to numbers via luaV_tonumber (sub_100576F0) and performs the double arithmetic op selected by TM event a4 (ADD/SUB/MUL/DIV/MOD/POW/UNM), writing a LUA_TNUMBER result, else dispatching the corresponding arithmetic metamethod.

name: luaZFillBuffer

name: luaZGetC

name: luaZInit

name: luaZRead

name: luaZOpenSpace
